## Checklist

- [ ] I used LunaDash Plugin SDK 2 metadata.
- [ ] The folder name matches the plugin ID.
- [ ] I included metadata.json, store.json, CMakeLists.txt, and LICENSE.
- [ ] I submitted source only; no built binaries, archives, generated shaders, or build receipts.
- [ ] The plugin defaults to disabled.
- [ ] I ran the repository validation scripts.
- [ ] I tested against a compatible LunaDash build.
